legend: Highly polymorphic tumour cells are intermingled with numerous eosinophils; the neoplastic cells are polymorphic, sometimes with bilobated nuclei (<<32070>>). The tumour cells show metachromatic granules (Giemsa) (<<32071>>). Immunohistochemistry shows strong cytoplasmic tryptase expression (<<32072>>). Strong membranous expression of KIT (CD117) (<<32073>>). The tumour cells are positive for CD25 (<<32074>>) and CD30 (<<32075>>).
